stem: The reader can conclude that Sensei in the excerpt from Kokoro is DIFFERENT from Amit in the story “The List” because Sensei —

options.label: A
options.text: concedes that the abilities of others may exceed his own

options.label: B
options.text: cares about the person who comes to him for advice

options.label: C
options.text: recognizes the distress of the person who asks for advice

options.label: D
options.text: values maintaining his reputation above other priorities
